text: Things the child loves (bubbles, a cartoon, grandma). They go in a Favorites folder.
The app will create a full core vocabulary with folders, your favorites and quick phrases.

The library downloads boards that other families and therapists shared. Nothing about your child is sent. If you share a board, only the board itself and the title and description you write are uploaded, under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license.
While you switch the microphone on (top bar), this device listens to what you say and highlights words that could answer. Speech is recognized on this device; audio is never saved or sent.

There is no empty cell in Favorites or on the main board. Hide or remove a word there first: words never move to make room.
